pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions exhibiting sharp, jagged edge gradients and high contrast against the interstitial lines. The spatial area of patches is greatest on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries toward the hindquarters and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological network of light-colored interstitial pathways. The negative space forms a graph with predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-body, narrowing slightly at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette visible along the dorsal ridge of the neck and withers, formed by individual hair tufts against the sky background.
